preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 5 * 10**5 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: Number of points in each test case is between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 < c <= 10**9 for c in Cs)
preconditions.description: Value of c is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= xi <= 10**9 for xi in Xs)
all(-10**9 <= yi <= 10**9 for yi in Ys)

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and len(line.split()) == 2 for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly two integers separated by a space.
The number of checkpoints is at least 1.
The number of moves is non-negative.
